name: aarambha-tours-and-travels-monorepo
description: Aarambha Tours & Travels full-stack monorepo (Express API + Next.js Website + Vite CRM)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,WEBSITE,CRM" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/website" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/crm"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend/website && npm run build --prefix frontend/crm
